accessibility.suggestion: Run agent-desktop permissions --guide. It opens System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility (Device Control and Data Access on macOS 27 and later) with a guide that shows which app to drag into the list: the app that launches agent-desktop, such as Terminal, iTerm, or Codex. If macOS lists the built binary separately, add that binary too.
